text:
maya: FYI: prod logs show a burst of kms.wrap_failure errors from a new partner-onboard service at ~14:05 UTC. not sure if this is leaking creds or an RNG issue. tagging @raj @sam
raj: can you paste the redacted log?
maya: snippet:
```n{"ts":"2026-03-24T14:05:12Z","evt":"kms.wrap_failure","key":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/tenant-wrap","caller":"svc-partner-onboard@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com","err":"entropy_low"}
```
sam: "entropy_low" points to client-side RNG. did the partner agent bundle a custom PRNG?
raj: their image uses a small distroless base we haven't validated. infra-bot, did the recent partner rollout modify any key binding or IAM?
infra-bot: deploy partner-onboard v1.3 to prod at 2026-03-24T13:40Z. No IAM or KMS policy edits recorded.
maya: triage plan: (1) repro in staging with the partner SA (sam), (2) instrument prod node RNG health and rotate the agent process if entropy below threshold (raj), (3) add verbose audit export for 4h (maya).
sam: will repro in staging now. if staging passes, likely prod environment.
raj: adding a short-lived watchdog cron to check /proc/sys/kernel/random/entropy_avail and restart onboarding container if < 200. deploying to a small canary set now. ETA 20m.
maya: also creating SEC-TRIAGE-501, include decision tree for key rotation (who signs off, rollback plan). don't rotate yet unless we see malformed wrap payloads or unauthorized unwraps.
security-bot: alert rule created: kms.wrap_failure rate spike > 50 in 30m (prod). will page if breached.
sam: repro succeeded in staging only when we forced a low-entropy VM. switching agent to use getrandom() fixed it. will open PR to fallback to OS RNG.
raj: canary watchdog in prod shows two hosts with entropy_avg ~40. restarting the agent on those hosts cleared errors. I'm scheduling a full sweep and will add a follow-up infra ticket to roll images to a variant with the getrandom() patch.
maya: thanks. next: sam -> PR to fallback to OS RNG (ETA 3h). raj -> full host sweep + ticket (ETA 6h). i'll keep audit export running for 4h and update SEC-TRIAGE-501. keep updates short here. :)
